title: Runner Mass · Phase 01
objective: Add useful mass and strength while preserving the quality of Adrian's running week.
principle: Progress only when the strength work stays compatible with the next run. Upper-body progression may move faster than lower-body progression.
progression_rules: Keep 1–2 good reps in reserve. No grinders and no failure.
Week 01 establishes repeatable loads and clean execution.
In Week 02, if every prescribed set was clean and the following run was normal, add the smallest practical load or add reps inside the range. Change one variable at a time.
In Week 03, confirm the Week 02 progression. Do not add load merely because the calendar advanced.
If lower-body work makes the next run meaningfully heavy, alters mechanics, or creates persistent soreness, repeat or reduce the lower-body dose before progressing.
Record every set, load, rep result and relevant running response. Missing evidence stays missing.

weeks.name: Baseline
weeks.intent: Find repeatable loads. Learn the dose. Finish every session able to train again.

weeks.name: Progress
weeks.intent: Beat Week 01 by the smallest useful amount without changing the running week.
weeks.progression_note: Use Week 01 loads as the starting reference. If a movement reached the top of its range cleanly, add the smallest practical load. Otherwise add reps inside the range. Lower-body progression requires a normal following run.

weeks.name: Confirm
weeks.intent: Hold the progression and prove it is compatible with running. No test week and no maximal lifting.
weeks.progression_note: Keep the Week 02 load when it is working and earn the top of the rep range. Add another small step only where recovery and running remain normal. If lower-body work taxed the run week, repeat or trim the dose rather than forcing progression.
